text_block_list.text:
Watching the horse girls in the middle of 
training—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fuh-fuh-fuuun~♪ Great weather, great 
breeze, feeling wonderful~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I could run forever like this! 
Wherever the wind blows, wherever it 
guides me~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I wondered what all the 
commotion was... So it's you, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is designated training hours, isn't 
it? Where on earth do you think you're 
heading?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~n♪ Hey, hey, will you listen to my 
story?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just a moment ago over on that course, I 
found a patch where lots of clovers were 
growing!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...And?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It was such a delightfully happy sight~. 
It made the joy of running feel doubled♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Groove-san, you love 
flowers, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's go look at them together! We can 
search for four-leaf clovers♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*. Focus on your running during 
training!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You should know full well the speeds 
umamusume run at! If you get distracted 
and look away, you'll injure yourself!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah... you're worried about me, aren't 
you! That makes me so very happy, thank 
you♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
............No. This is a stern warning to 
stop fooling around and practice 
seriously!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Practice or anything else, it's such 
a waste if you don't enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right, don't you think so too? Come on, 
person over there!
choice_data_list:
Running with someone makes it even more 
fun
Having fun while practicing is important

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, exactly! Then Groove-san, let's run 
together♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
While I show you where the clovers are, 
let's race all the way around♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If you approach it with total 
seriousness, I'll indulge you. However, if 
you remain frivolous, you'll lose in an 
instant.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me! As long as it's fun, anything 
makes me happy♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Muu~, you sound just like Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not just 'like' me, that is word for word 
what I said. Unless you run seriously, you 
will never grasp victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Show some grit, and try passing me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Passing Groove-san? Which means...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see, it's a game of tag!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
First I'll run away, so come chase me! 
Here I go~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, what I just said was about races in 
general...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. If you claim you'll run 
with all your might, I'll take you on!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Every single practice must 
be turned into a precious memory!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, maybe I should take photos of this 
practice? If I use burst mode, maybe 
something interesting will show up♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll go get ready right away♪ See you in a 
bit, Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fine...! Good grief, I can never keep 
up with your whims!

Though looking thoroughly exasperated, Air 
Groove stood by the edge of the course for 
a while, quietly keeping watch over Fine 
Motion as she took photos.
